xBRIEFInfo.description: Proposed cross-course assessment and learner-support scope
xBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup

plan.title: Assessments, Solutions, Troubleshooting, and Learner Navigation

narratives.Description: Complete and normalize the practical evidence, feedback, recovery, and navigation surfaces across the core course and capstone. This scope closes self-directed gaps that only become visible once substantive modules exist.
narratives.Acceptance: Every learning outcome maps to practical evidence and useful feedback; every exercise has progressive hints and an explained solution; every lab has expected failures, recovery, reset, cleanup, and an unambiguous done condition; and course navigation tells learners how to start, resume, continue, and get unstuck without an instructor.
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance command; do not embed the aggregate gate in plan.acceptance.commands.

items.title: Map learning outcomes to practical assessments and feedback

narrative.Acceptance: Every core outcome has an observable evidence requirement, scoring or comparison guidance, and actionable feedback rather than trivia-only recall.

items.title: Normalize solutions, troubleshooting, recovery, and navigation

narrative.Acceptance: A learner can resume or recover every practical task from written material alone and can access solutions after a clearly suggested first attempt.
